gaps.explanation: Detail holds only four one-line fund totals from the p14 Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Balances - Budgetary Basis - Budget and Actual - All Funds: detail 154 Electric 4,798,518.37, 155 Waste 501,179.25, 156 Wastewater 602,143.34, 157 Water 444,915.53 = 6,346,756.49. Business-type revenue (above) is taken from the p10 proprietary fund columns, so, as in the Gothenburg_FY2025 fix, the p10 expense rows are added per fund column (Total column not used): Electric Less: Cost of purchased power 3,050,292.16 + 12 operating rows 1,727,512.51 + Interest expense 16,619.83 = 4,794,424.50; Water 12 operating rows 555,420.65 + Interest expense 13,863.19 = 569,283.84; Sewer 12 operating rows 719,960.89 + Interest expense 18,862.67 = 738,823.56; Waste 4 rows (Administrative services 63.36, Trash haulers 490,691.89, Recycling fee 8,735.58, Miscellaneous 1,000.00) = 500,490.83. Sum 6,603,022.73 = the JSON business-type statement lines. Each p14 line is the same fund's spending as the added p10 rows of that fund (budgetary basis instead of accrual), so all four are removed: detail 154 Electric 4,798,518.37 -> held by the added Electric rows (4,794,424.50); detail 155 Waste 501,179.25 -> held by the added Waste rows (500,490.83; p10 prints Waste Total operating expenses 501,179.25); detail 156 Wastewater 602,143.34 -> held by the added Sewer rows (738,823.56; p14 'Wastewater' = p10 'Sewer'); detail 157 Water 444,915.53 -> held by the added Water rows (569,283.84). Remaining (report does not add up, no fix): the p10 printed operating-expense rows add to 3,503,384.88, not the printed Total operating expenses 3,512,665.37 - Electric rows 1,727,512.51 vs 1,733,461.89 (5,949.38), Water 555,420.65 vs 556,659.42 (1,238.77), Sewer 719,960.89 vs 721,364.81 (1,403.92), Waste 500,490.83 vs 501,179.25 (688.42); 9,280.49 in all (in report_discrepancies). No printed row carries it, so detail = 6,603,022.73 ties to the JSON statement lines but is 9,280.49 below the printed p10 total 6,612,303.22 (3,050,292.16 + 3,512,665.37 + 49,345.69). Business-type transfers out (290,000.00 / 28,013.00 / 13,866.00, p11) stay as the pass-2 lines; no other nonoperating or other-financing rows printed.
